title: They Say, One Knows
goal: Talk about unnamed people with a plural verb and talk about people in general with uno.

items: I can use a plural verb with no subject for rumours and for unknown doers.
I can use uno or una for a general truth that includes me.
I can use the new words for rumours, stealing and resigning.
